canonical_title: OpenAI tests business-sponsored agents in ChatGPT ads
treatment: Repeat only for broader availability, material ad/agent behavior changes, pricing, privacy controls, or international rollout.
known_facts: OpenAI began testing clearly labeled business-sponsored agents with select U.S. advertisers.
Sponsored agents are separated from ChatGPT independent responses and the user's original chat.
ChatGPT Ads Manager uses natural-language prompts to create, update and analyze ad campaigns.
HubSpot is the first CRM partner and Shopify the first e-commerce partner; Shopify international rollout is planned from September 23 where ChatGPT Ads is available.
reinclude_only_if: Sponsored Agents expand beyond the initial U.S. advertiser test.
OpenAI publishes material privacy, ranking, pricing, or agent-control changes.
The September 23 Shopify rollout materially changes availability.
